verdict.rationale: Paxos is a stablecoin, payments and crypto-brokerage API platform, not an agent or AI application that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows it acting as an MCP client. The AI assistance built into its documentation and its llms.txt files are documentation aids, not MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
